auto_filled.title: Mountfield T30M Gear Drive 2-in-1 Lawn Tractor
auto_filled.description: Mountfield T30M Lawn Tractor This ride-on mower will collect or mulch making it a 2-in-1 machine. Having come to a special arrangement with the manufacturer, are now able to provide our customers with an unbeatable deal on this powerful, high-specification lawn tractor from classic British brand, Mountfield! The Mountfield T30M is the perfect 'go to' lawn and garden tractor for customers seeking coverage for lawns around the one acre size. What sets the T30M apart is its twin-bladed 84cm cutter deck - a rare feature in a compact tractor of this size. Twin blades provide a neater, more consistent finish on uneven ground and improve bagging performance, making it possible to mow damp grass without clogging the discharge chute. The deck is fitted with gauge wheels to prevent scalping and turf damage when navigating uneven terrain. Power comes from a 414cc STIGA air-cooled four-stroke engine delivering 8.4hp. Equipped with overhead-valve (OHV) technology, the engine offers reduced noise, lower emissions and excellent fuel efficiency. A six-litre petrol tank and electric key start maximise productivity by reducing downtime and ensuring stress-free starting every time. The Mountfield T30M offers versatile mowing options to suit changing conditions. Grass can be collected in the spacious 200-litre rear bag, rear-discharged directly onto the lawn, or mulched to provide a natural feed for your turf. A seven-position cutting-height adjustment and six-speed manual transmission (5+1) further enhance flexibility. To prolong the life of the cutter deck, Mountfield have incorporated a clever little cleaning port. Simply click your Hozelock attachment to the deck wash, lower your deck, then when you turn the water on and engage your cutters, watch the magic happen! Practical features include from-the-seat grassbag emptying, a front-mounted bumper for engine protection, push-button PTO engagement and a smooth-riding, fully adjustable seat with sprung suspension. The tractor also includes a convenient mow-in-reverse function, saving time and effort when manoeuvring in tight spaces. We think this is just the perfect size lawn tractor to facilitate gardens around the 1 acre size. If you are looking for something a little on the smaller size for the not so large areas, you may wish to look at the MTF66MQ-827, also from Mountfield. This is a compact rider style mower: Why not scroll down to the bottom of this page to see what other products/services we offer in conjunction with this mower?

custom.feature_bullets.raw_value:
• Unbeatable Value: The best deal available for a lawn tractor of this specification—unmatched in quality and performance!
  • Ready to Use: Price includes full assembly and a comprehensive pre-shipping inspection, so your tractor arrives ready to mow.
  • Innovative Twin-Blade Design: The first-ever garden tractor with a twin-bladed cutter deck under 90cm, delivering a cleaner, more consistent cut.
  • Exceptional Damp-Weather Performance: Twin blades ensure superior grass collection, even in damp or challenging conditions.
  • Convenient Grassbag Design: A spacious, 200-litre grassbag minimises downtime and can be emptied without leaving the driver’s seat.
  • Overfill Protection: The collector’s full alarm prevents overfilling and blockages, ensuring uninterrupted mowing.
  • Precision Cutting: Seven preset cutting heights, easily adjusted with a spring-assisted lever for perfect lawn customisation.
  • Versatile Drive Options: A six-speed manual transmission (five forward, one reverse) provides the ideal speed for any mowing task.
  • Effortless Manoeuvrability: A tight turning radius makes end-of-pass realignment quick and easy.
  • Comfortable Operation: Enjoy light-touch steering and an adjustable high-back seat for a smooth, comfortable ride.
  • Turf-Friendly Design: Large-diameter drive wheels enhance manoeuvrability and help prevent turf damage.
  • Enhanced Safety: Built-in headlights ensure safe mowing and towing, even in low-light conditions.
  • Powerful Performance: Equipped with a high-performance 414cc STIGA 4-stroke OHV engine for reliable, fuel-efficient operation.
  • Time-Saving Feature: Mow-in-reverse capability allows you to tackle hard-to-reach areas without interruption.
  • Customisable Options: Mulch kit and Tow Hitch included and rear deflector optional attachment to tailor your tractor to your needs.
  • Expand Your Capabilities: Choose from a range of trailed accessories to enhance your lawn care toolkit.
  • Peace of Mind: Backed by an extended five-year manufacturer’s warranty for long-term reliability.

validator_will_check.value_list_fields: value must appear in the column's value_list (case sensitive)

validator_will_check.uom_fields: columns ending _uom are value-lists; pair each numeric spec (e.g. width_4) with its unit (width_4_uom)

guidance: Fill REQUIRED spec columns first (dimensions+_uom, material, wattage, feature_1..3), then RECOMMENDED/OPTIONAL. Map custom.feature_bullets <li> items to feature_1..N. For each numeric dimension also set its *_uom partner from the unit value-list. For value-list columns write an EXACT value from value_list or mark UNKNOWN.
